opportunities.name: Blessing Damage Charge
opportunities.objective: Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement.
opportunities.mechanic: W heals both Kayle and an ally and has AP-scaled movement. Q/actual attacks can store Helia champion damage before W; Staff grants AP/haste after allied healing, supporting E passive magic and a later W. R gives invulnerability access to preserve the beneficiary.
opportunities.requiredState: W affects another ally after Kayle deals champion damage; record level/Exalted state.
opportunities.failure: Utility investment reduces carry damage and W mana/cooldown limits repetition.
opportunities.test: Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Self-only healing does not satisfy Helia/Staff allied trigger.

opportunities.name: Exalted Wave Threshold
opportunities.objective: Separate wave, E and ordinary attack damage above and below 40%.
opportunities.mechanic: At level 11 Exalted attacks launch AP magic waves and at 16 Exalted is permanent. E also adds AP magic and missing-health damage; Shadowflame tests qualifying low-health wave/E packets while Riftmaker rewards real combat duration. Nashor supports actual attacks and Q removes both resists before delivery.
opportunities.requiredState: Level 11 with five P stacks or level 16; target below 40% for Shadowflame.
opportunities.failure: Pre-Exalted state removes waves or kiting prevents ramp.
opportunities.test: Separate wave, E and ordinary attack damage above and below 40%; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rageblade on-hit repetition is not proof of duplicated fire waves.

ruledOut.reason: P requires level 11 plus Exalted for waves and level 16 for permanent Exalted.

unknowns: E explosion threshold is a runtime token; wave crit/on-hit inheritance is not established by this source.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.name: Blessing Damage Charge
builds.summary: Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement.
builds.goal: Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement.
builds.hypothesis: W heals both Kayle and an ally and has AP-scaled movement. Q/actual attacks can store Helia champion damage before W; Staff grants AP/haste after allied healing, supporting E passive magic and a later W. R gives invulnerability access to preserve the beneficiary.
testPlan: Required state: W affects another ally after Kayle deals champion damage; record level/Exalted state.
Measure Helia charge use and ally attack uptime during W movement; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Utility investment reduces carry damage and W mana/cooldown limits repetition.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Self-only healing does not satisfy Helia/Staff allied trigger.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap, Cryptbloom, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Attacks deal an additional [15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 + (0.2) × AP + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage.

Active: Kayle's next attack becomes ranged and deals an additional [(8 / 8.5 / 9 / 9.5 / 10 + (0.015) × AP) × (0.01)] missing Health magic damage. This attack upgrades when Kayle reaches Level @Spell.KaylePassive:LevelForPassiveRank2@, causing it to explode when it hits the target, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Kayle fires a celestial sword that stops on the first enemy hit, dealing [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.5) × AP + (0.6) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage, Slowing by [25 / 30 / 35 / 40 / 45]% for [2] seconds, and removing [15]% Armor and Magic Resist for [4] seconds from the target and enemies behind them.

Kayle's attacks rank up as she gains levels and spends skill points.

Level [1] - Zealous: Attacks grant [6]% Attack Speed for [5] seconds (max 5 stacks). At max stacks Kayle becomes Exalted, gaining [10]% Move Speed.
Level [6] - Arisen: Attack range is increased to [525].
Level [11] - Aflame: Exalted attacks launch fire waves that deal [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=20, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 12, "mBonusPerLevelAtAndAfter": 3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + (0.25) × AP + (0.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage.
Level [16] - Transcendent: Become permanently Exalted. Attack range is increased to [625].

Kayle infuses herself and an allied champion with light, restoring [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.25) × AP] Health and granting [0.24 / 0.28 / 0.32 / 0.36 / 0.4 + (0.0008) × AP] Move Speed for [2] seconds.
Kayle makes an allied champion Invulnerable for [2.5] seconds and then purifies the area around them, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.7) × AP + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage to nearby enemies.
